meta.title: ROBO > SOC | University Robotics Society
meta.description: University of Nottingham Robotics Society: workshops, robotics projects and the UniBots competition, open to every student.

about.heading: Who are we?
paragraphs: [[RoboSoc]] runs weekly hands-on workshops that teach you how to build a robot. Every month will cover a different aspect of the process so that by the end of the year you’ll have built a fully functioning robot.
bullets: OPEN TO ALL: Any course, any level
about.imageAlt: RoboSoc members testing a robot together at UniBots

competition.heading: Build. Learn. Compete.
competition.body: Join a team to compete in the UniBots competition. No experience is needed since all our workshops will prepare you and your team to compete by the end of the year.

points.label: SKILLS_TAUGHT
points.text: Arduino, CAD, coding, electronics and mechanical engineering.

points.label: KIT_INCLUDED
points.text: Tools, parts and resources for your build.

points.label: TEAM_SUPPORT
points.text: Weekly workshops, year-long curriculum, lively community.

competition.imageAlt: RoboSoc workshop with students learning robotics together
